title: Server: GET /games catalog endpoint
description: Add GET /games endpoint that returns the list of available game definitions. Reads from games/ directory. Response: array of {name, players (min/max or named list), information, file} objects. Cached at startup, no filesystem reads per request. Client uses this to populate game picker in lobby. Defensive: validate each JSON on load, skip invalid files with warning.
close_reason: GET /games endpoint returns sorted catalog of game definitions with name, file, players. Skips invalid files with warning.
